place_fields.summary: Jod Gumbaz is a complex of two tombs from the late Adil Shahi period in Vijayapura, associated with Khan Muhammad and Abdul Razzaq Qadiri.

planning_attributes.legend_or_history: The tomb complex dates to the late Adil Shahi period and includes the tomb of Abdul Razzaq Qadiri, which is revered as a dargah.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: The site is in Vijayapura and can be reached within the city by local road transport.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: Treat the historic masonry and tomb precinct respectfully and use accessible paths.

place_fields.summary: Jamia Masjid is a prominent Adil Shahi-era mosque in Vijayapura, noted for its large courtyard, arches, dome, prayer spaces and gilded Quranic calligraphy.

planning_attributes.description: Historic congregational mosque and major Adil Shahi architectural monument.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: The mosque was built under Adil Shah I and is associated with the Adil Shahi period; it is described as an incomplete structure lacking its two minarets.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Jamia Masjid is in Vijayapura and is reachable by local road transport from within the city.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: As an active mosque, visitors should respect prayer times, dress appropriately and follow local instructions.
